<header class="dg-head dg-head-section"><p class="dg-kicker">Appendix B <span class="dg-sep">•</span> <a href="index.html">Proofs &amp; Comments</a></p><h1 class="dg-title"><span class="dg-secnum">B.7</span> The topology of the tangent bundle (§<a class="dg-xref" href="../fields/vector-fields.html" data-kind="section" data-label="section_Vector_Fields">5.1</a>)</h1></header>
<p>We prove that <span class="math inline">\(\mathcal{O}_{T\mathcal{M}}\)</span>, as defined in Section <a class="dg-xref" href="../fields/vector-fields.html" data-kind="section" data-label="section_Vector_Fields">5.1</a>, is a topology on <span class="math inline">\(T\mathcal{M}\)</span>, and that w.r.t. it every <span class="math inline">\(T\mathcal{U}\)</span> is open, every bundle chart map <span class="math inline">\(\xi_{\mathscr{X}}\)</span> is a homeomorphism onto <span class="math inline">\(\mathscr{X}(\mathcal{U}) \times \mathbb{R}^d\)</span>, and <span class="math inline">\(\pi\)</span> is continuous. The only inputs are that every <span class="math inline">\(\xi_{\mathscr{X}}\)</span> is a bijection onto the open set <span class="math inline">\(\mathscr{X}(\mathcal{U}) \times \mathbb{R}^d\)</span>, and that every transition map <span class="math inline">\(\xi_{\mathscr{Y}} \circ \xi_{\mathscr{X}}^{-1}\)</span> is a homeomorphism (in fact a smooth bijection with smooth inverse) between the open sets <span class="math inline">\(\mathscr{X}(\mathcal{U} \cap \mathcal{V}) \times \mathbb{R}^d\)</span> and <span class="math inline">\(\mathscr{Y}(\mathcal{U} \cap \mathcal{V}) \times \mathbb{R}^d\)</span>.</p>
<ol class="dg-enumerate dg-depth-1">
<li><p><em><span class="math inline">\(\mathcal{O}_{T\mathcal{M}}\)</span> is a topology.</em></p>
<ul class="dg-itemize dg-depth-1">
<li><p><span class="math inline">\(\xi_{\mathscr{X}}(\emptyset \cap T\mathcal{U}) = \emptyset\)</span> and <span class="math inline">\(\xi_{\mathscr{X}}(T\mathcal{M} \cap T\mathcal{U}) = \mathscr{X}(\mathcal{U}) \times \mathbb{R}^d\)</span> are open for every chart, so <span class="math inline">\(\emptyset, T\mathcal{M} \in \mathcal{O}_{T\mathcal{M}}\)</span>.</p></li>
<li><p>Since <span class="math inline">\(\xi_{\mathscr{X}}\)</span> is injective, images commute with intersections: <span class="math inline">\(\xi_{\mathscr{X}}\big( (W_1 \cap W_2) \cap T\mathcal{U} \big) = \xi_{\mathscr{X}}(W_1 \cap T\mathcal{U}) \cap \xi_{\mathscr{X}}(W_2 \cap T\mathcal{U})\)</span>, an intersection of two open sets.</p></li>
<li><p>Images always commute with unions: <span class="math inline">\(\xi_{\mathscr{X}}\big( (\bigcup_\alpha W_\alpha) \cap T\mathcal{U} \big) = \bigcup_\alpha \xi_{\mathscr{X}}(W_\alpha \cap T\mathcal{U})\)</span>, a union of open sets.</p></li>
</ul></li>
<li><p><em>Every <span class="math inline">\(T\mathcal{V}\)</span> is open:</em> for every chart <span class="math inline">\((\mathcal{U}, \mathscr{X})\)</span>, <span class="math inline">\(\xi_{\mathscr{X}}(T\mathcal{V} \cap T\mathcal{U}) = \mathscr{X}(\mathcal{U} \cap \mathcal{V}) \times \mathbb{R}^d\)</span>, which is open.</p></li>
<li><p><em>Every <span class="math inline">\(\xi_{\mathscr{X}}\)</span> is a homeomorphism onto <span class="math inline">\(\mathscr{X}(\mathcal{U}) \times \mathbb{R}^d\)</span>.</em> It is a bijection by construction.</p>
<ul class="dg-itemize dg-depth-1">
<li><p><em>Open map:</em> if <span class="math inline">\(W \subseteq T\mathcal{U}\)</span> is open, then <span class="math inline">\(\xi_{\mathscr{X}}(W) = \xi_{\mathscr{X}}(W \cap T\mathcal{U})\)</span> is open by definition of <span class="math inline">\(\mathcal{O}_{T\mathcal{M}}\)</span>.</p></li>
<li><p><em>Continuity:</em> let <span class="math inline">\(O \subseteq \mathscr{X}(\mathcal{U}) \times \mathbb{R}^d\)</span> be open and <span class="math inline">\(W \coloneqq \xi_{\mathscr{X}}^{-1}(O)\)</span>. For any chart <span class="math inline">\((\mathcal{V}, \mathscr{Y})\)</span>,  <span class="math display">\[
                    \xi_{\mathscr{Y}}(W \cap T\mathcal{V})
                    = \big( \xi_{\mathscr{Y}} \circ \xi_{\mathscr{X}}^{-1} \big)\Big( O \cap \big( \mathscr{X}(\mathcal{U} \cap \mathcal{V}) \times \mathbb{R}^d \big) \Big),
                \]</span>  the image of an open set under a homeomorphism between open subsets of <span class="math inline">\(\mathbb{R}^{2d}\)</span>, hence open. Thus <span class="math inline">\(W \in \mathcal{O}_{T\mathcal{M}}\)</span>.</p></li>
</ul></li>
<li><p><em><span class="math inline">\(\pi\)</span> is continuous:</em> for <span class="math inline">\(\mathcal{U}' \in \mathcal{O}\)</span> and every chart <span class="math inline">\((\mathcal{U}, \mathscr{X})\)</span>, <span class="math inline">\(\xi_{\mathscr{X}}\big( \operatorname{preim}_\pi(\mathcal{U}') \cap T\mathcal{U} \big) = \mathscr{X}(\mathcal{U} \cap \mathcal{U}') \times \mathbb{R}^d\)</span>, which is open. <span class="math inline">\(\square\)</span></p></li>
</ol>
